title: Scissor lifts and operator competency
moduleTitle: Optional add-on: high-risk work and platform licences
audience: Workers and supervisors who may be asked to work at height or on a platform. Optional add-on, taken alongside the main courses.
learningOutcomes: State where the WP licence does not apply to scissor lifts, as confirmed by an official page.
Explain why operator competency still applies to scissor lifts.

instruction.heading: Victoria
instruction.body: WorkSafe Victoria's high risk work licence page indicates that scissor lifts do not need the WP licence (page reviewed 30 June 2026).

instruction.heading: Northern Territory
instruction.body: The Northern Territory bulletin says a high risk work licence is not required for scissor lifts (no date shown).

instruction.heading: Competency still applies
instruction.body: The same Northern Territory bulletin says the PCBU must ensure scissor lift operator competency so far as reasonably practicable (no date shown).

instruction.heading: Limit of this lesson
instruction.body: This lesson does not confirm the scissor lift rule for other states. Check the regulator for your state before using a scissor lift.

procedure: Check the state rule on the regulator's page for scissor lifts.
Confirm the operator's competency before use, so far as is reasonably practicable.
Record the page date and the competency check.

workedExamples.situation: A business uses a scissor lift in the Northern Territory and asks whether the operator needs the WP licence.
workedExamples.decisionPrompt: What does the NT bulletin in this lesson support?
workedExamples.reasoning: It supports that a high risk work licence is not required for scissor lifts, but it also says operator competency must be ensured so far as reasonably practicable. Competency is still a duty.

commonErrors.error: Treating no licence as no duty.
commonErrors.prevention: Competency checks still apply to scissor lift operators.

safetyAndRegulatory.point: A scissor lift licence position does not remove the duty to confirm operator competency. This add-on grants no licence.

qualityStandard: Learner states the licence position and the competency duty separately.
documentationEvidence: Operator competency check recorded with the page date of the rule relied on.
summary: Victoria and the Northern Territory do not require the WP licence for scissor lifts, per their pages.

knowledgeChecks.question: Which statement about scissor lifts is supported in this lesson?
options: Scissor lifts need the boom-type WP licence in every state
Victoria's page indicates scissor lifts do not need the WP licence
Scissor lifts never need competency checks

officialReferences.title: High risk work licence (WorkSafe Victoria)
officialReferences.covers: Names the boom-type elevating work platform operation licence class; states the class without a boom length; scissor lifts do not need the WP licence. Does not state whether the class applies at any boom length.

officialReferences.title: Elevating work platform operation licence requirements (WorkSafe NT bulletin)
officialReferences.covers: WP licence where the boom length is 11 metres or more; scissor lifts do not need a high risk work licence; PCBU must ensure scissor lift operator competency so far as reasonably practicable.
